prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT BACK view facing directly AWAY, only back of head and tunic visible; NO face, NO eyes, NO chest laces. Frame 1 torso recoils sideways with head tilted and arms thrown loosely apart; knees buckle but shoes stay planted. Frame 2 shoulders recover toward slack stooped stance and arms settle. Same full anatomical size, same shoe ground row, distinct poses. Not dead or fallen flat. No impact/flash/blood effect. Complete figure about 760px tall with generous transparent gutters around head, hands and shoes.
